samples.prose-paragraph: A token estimate is only useful if you know which way it is wrong. Overcounting wastes part of the window you paid for, while undercounting means the request is rejected after you have already spent the time assembling it. Those two outcomes are not equivalent, so an estimator should let you choose which one it prefers.
